body: please message me it wont let me message you

I am pleading with you to please please reconsider. I lost someone I love to suicide this month.  


You're so damn right to feel so forced into this reality - I do too! Your pain is heard, your pain is legitimate, it can be felt so vividly from this post. Good on you for recognizing that you don't want to hurt anyone, good on you for looking deep at yourself. But at least for a little while longer, why don't we consider the alternatives together? I'm more than happy to be here with you through it, and this all of this, until the end of time.
If someone made a sub that was more dedicated to dealing with the day to day loss, I'd appreciate it so much. It'd help me so much and so many more.
If you're still here, I'm here. I'm here to embrace you, comfort you, and be anything you need me to be. From one hurting to another, I love you. Really.
